messages:
Avery: Quick heads-up — planning a shortswap tomorrow 03/18 06:00 UTC in us-west-2: kernel v2.4 + quant profile slim-v2. Low-risk but want a quick owner/handshake + smoke/rollback plan. Who can own the window?
Priya: I can be on-call owner for the window, available 05:50-07:10 UTC. Will run smoke and monitor traces.
Sam: Can you add the CR link? I can review now if needed.
Avery: CR is https://phabricator/redwood/D12345 — mostly kernel flags and quant table bump. Sam: pinged you on the diff.
Noah: Quick checklist suggestion: 1) preflight on canary slice 2) run KV-cache warmup 3) smoke generation + latency + error-rate check 4) rollback validation.
Miguel: For smoke, recommend these quick commands (run from staging jumpbox):
```bash
# generate smoke sample
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"model":"engine-v2.4","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .text
# simple latency probe
for i in {1..10}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate; done
```
Priya: I'll run warmup + smoke. What should pass/fail thresholds be?
Noah: Fail if p95 latency > 800ms or error rate > 0.5% for the 10-sample smoke, or if any notable model-output corruption (truncated token streams).
Avery: Rollback plan: if smoke fails, revert quant-profile to slim-v1 and roll kernel back one revision: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/engine --to-revision=<prev>` and update configstore: `rcs update quant-profile=slim-v1`. Deploy-bot will post progress.
deploy-bot: Canary slice deployed to slice-7 at 06:00 UTC. Health checks passing (cpu/mem/ready).
Sam: I approved the CR, left one minor comment about a log line. Not blocking.
Miguel: I'll prep the rollback commands in the runbook and stash them in the deploy notes.
Priya: Runbook check complete, I have prometheus dashboards pinned + tracing span filter. I'll watch errors and p95.
Noah: If we need to pause, what's the communication channel? Use this thread + #eng-oncall and call if urgent.
Avery: Good. Priya is owner, Miguel does rollback runbook, Sam is CR reviewer, Noah monitoring thresholds. I'll be reachable for escalation. :thumbsup:
Priya: 👍 I'll post a short post-deploy sanity note after 06:15 UTC with p95 and error counts.
